name: io.github.garyyang-finchip/foga
title: FOGA node
description: A Finch OG Agent cell as an MCP server: read the world, dry-run and take ERC-8414 tenders by policy.

packageArguments.name: --config
packageArguments.description: the cell's configuration file (written by foga cell new and foga cell init)

packageArguments.name: --rpc
packageArguments.description: the JSON-RPC endpoint of the world's chain, when the configuration names none

environmentVariables.name: FOGA_OPERATOR_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: a file (mode 0600) holding the operator key: with it the server acts for the cell; without it, reads, dry runs and builds only

environmentVariables.name: FOGA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: the JSON-RPC endpoint when neither the configuration nor --rpc names one

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api key> for a caller the node's operator granted; without it the public reads and builds
